Players Committee card image of [[Din Djarin]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with an alien, adds one battle destiny. Once per turn, may target opponent's non-'hit' character here. If Din on table when target lost this turn, choose: retrieve 1 Force or place target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/dindjarin.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/dindjarin.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
